measurement: MP-R0B connected-only refusal (no runtime endpoint available)
note: Only the refusal is captured here: the connected CPU and working-set baseline was not measured because no reachable runtime endpoint exists in this environment. The refusal demonstrates that a connected run cannot be recorded against an unreachable endpoint.
foreground_attempt: A loopback listener satisfied reachability and the connected probe was run, but the application never produced a window, so the calls that use the Win32 helper - SetForegroundWindow, GetForegroundWindow and the UI Automation read - were never reached. Add-Type itself sits before the application launch, so the declaration ran; what is missing is an independent record that the type generation succeeded.
add_type_scope: Add-Type sits before the application launch, so the script reached and executed that declaration; what is missing is an independent record that the type generation succeeded, and the calls that use the type were never reached.
startup_refusal_scope: The 'instance ownership unavailable' message was captured from a separate direct launch (fixture mode, stderr redirected, port 47812). That run's cause is identified. The earlier connected probe ran under different conditions (-Connected -RejectProbe, port 47811) and its own stderr was not captured, so applying this cause to that attempt is not proven - the earlier attempt's cause stays unidentified.
